  P ≠ 0 → ∀ (a b : ℕ), (∀ i ∈ S, EndpointAffine (L i)) → 0 < mass ((betaWeight a b * ∏ i ∈ S, L i) * P ^ 2)

  [inst_2 : IsStrictOrderedRing K] {T : Finset K} {mu : K → K} {b : ℕ},
  UnitLaw T mu b → b + 1 + (exteriorSites T).card + 2 * (negativeInteriorSites T mu).card ≤ 2 * T.card
